question: Can measured initial features predict a new recipe full risk curve and U-turn without training outcomes?

data.source: closed-form_generator; no empirical prior OOD losses

forecast_protocol: stage forecast generates initial features/data and analytic spectral train signal/noise-variance/expected-risk curves; saves allvalues/hash, then separate train validates pin before SGD; no observed training loss used in forecast

predictions.claim: Actual clean-signal head train/test curves match their pre-training spectral forecasts.
MonteCarlo mean clean-test risk agrees with preregistered conditional expected risk within noise uncertainty.
predictions.criterion: at final and predicted beststep, mean-minus-forecast <=3*MonteCarloSE+1e-8 for>=90percent of48checks; alloutliers retained

predictions.claim: Noise-fitting component increases while noisy train loss decreases; predicted risk-minimum interval predicts actual MonteCarlo risk minimum approximately.
predictions.criterion: alltrain curves monotone tolerance1e-10; median absolute log2step error between MC meanmin and forecastmin <=2, with step0 excluded but reported

predictions.claim: Higher noise moves optimum earlier for a fixed kernel, and small SiLU delays weak mode noise variance at equal budget.
predictions.criterion: forecast beststep noise1.4 <=noise0.7 allrecipes; scale0.015 SiLU final expectednoisevariance<ReLU in3/3seeds

statistical_unit: one new target/distribution with three within-recipe feature/data repeats and16 noise draws each
